title: coap_keys_settings.c: GCC13 maybe-uninitialized Werror breaks native_sim build
description: collect_record() locals slot/entry fed parse_record_key() out-params; GCC 13 (heft, gcc 13.3) -Werror=maybe-uninitialized flags use at coap_keys_settings.c:170/:162 where GCC 12 did not. Blocks building tests/coap_keys and coap_keys_lifecycle on native_sim/native/64. Fix (landed this round with u4fr verification): initialize slot=0/entry=0 with comment; inert because use is gated on ret==0. Verified: coap_keys 37/37 PASS, coap_keys_lifecycle 9/9 PASS on native_sim/native/64 (Zephyr 4.1.0 workspace, zcbor 0.9.1 registered).
